text:
Nadia CSM: Heads-up  preparing the renewal packet for MARCUS-EDGE and noticed a sharp embed/token spike starting 48h ago. Need a one-slide "what happened + forecast + quick mitigations" for the QBR. Can FinOps & Eng help?

Owen (FinOps): On it. I pulled commit vs actual and can produce a 3-scenario table (baseline / trend / surge). Also will recommend a temporary cushion for renewal.

Liam Eng: I see a burst from /v1/embeds/bulk_create. Traces show lots of tiny parallel requests rather than batched calls. Could be a changed client integration. Adding a tagging rule to capture client_user_agent.

Priyanka (Enablement): I'll draft a 1-page adoption checklist for batching + prefix caching and a short snippet customers can paste into their SDK usage guide.

usage-bot: Alert: MARCUS-EDGE has crossed 78% of monthly allocation. AlertID: U-11277

Nadia CSM: Concrete asks: 1) Owen  scenario numbers + recommended cushion by 15:30. 2) Liam  root-cause snippet + short-term guard (rate limit or concurrency cap) ETA 30m. 3) Priyanka  checklist draft and code snippet by EOD. I'll draft a customer outreach proposing mitigation call and attach the slide.

Owen (FinOps): Quick baseline numbers: 30d=900k tokens, 7d=360k, monthly_commit=1.0M.
Projection simple linear:
- baseline (no change) = 1.1M
- trend (current rate) = 1.6M
- surge (if growth continues) = 2.2M
Recommendation: add 15% cushion in renewal; offer one-off credits if they adopt batching before renewal.

Liam Eng: Deploying a temporary concurrency cap of 8 on /v1/embeds/bulk_create. Also adding telemetry tag to requests missing "batch-size" header.

Liam Eng: Short-term curl to set soft throttle (ops only):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/limits \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \ 
  -d '{"account":"MARCUS-EDGE","route":"/v1/embeds/bulk_create","soft_limit":800}'
```

Priyanka (Enablement): Draft checklist items: enable batching header, set max_batch_size=128, reduce embedding frequency for background jobs, enable prefix dedupe/cache. I'll attach Node/Python snippets.

Nadia CSM: I'll send a short customer note offering a 30-min remediation call and propose the temporary soft throttle until batching is adopted. Adding a "savings if adopted" slide: Owen, can you estimate savings assuming 2.5x token reduction on top routes?

Owen (FinOps): Yes  if batching reduces token usage 2.5x on top 3 routes, projected month drops to ~920k (under commit). I'll add a before/after chart.

usage-bot: Alert acknowledged: trending down after concurrency cap.

Nadia CSM: Great work, team. I'll attach Owen's scenarios and Priyanka's checklist to the QBR appendix and track adoption in the renewal playbook. Will ping if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
